note: Same 96 seeds in every arm. on = all story numbers, the church bell and the hill siren; off = scenes still open but every story number is neutral; beats = only that scene's numbers removed; choices = one choice fixed per path, the other at its default. Do not edit by hand.

seconds.label: t on the night clock at first light (shown as the clock); every t is run through the solver (the held bells and a dry cell being cranked included, no flat additions)

fails.label: failures in the night: a turn lost and relaunched at the last mark (it ran off the posts, wandered 200 t, or the cell went dry after the cut), a dry cell Kit has to crank, or a catch arm struck and the motor jammed; each raises a failure banner and counts on the Failures counter

red.label: t run with the cell gauge in the red (charge below 0.30); a reading of the charge the beats change, not a play result
